description: This file exports functions, types, and constants related to task flow management from the 'task-flow-registry.js' module. It acts as an interface for task flow operations such as creation, deletion, listing, and status updates.

methods.name: createTaskFlowForTask
methods.description: Creates a new task flow associated with a specific task.

methods.name: createFlowRecord
methods.description: Creates a new flow record for tracking task flow status.

methods.name: createManagedTaskFlow
methods.description: Establishes a managed task flow with internal controls.

methods.name: deleteTaskFlowRecordById
methods.description: Deletes a task flow record identified by its ID.

methods.name: findLatestTaskFlowForOwnerKey
methods.description: Finds the most recent task flow for a specific owner key.

methods.name: failFlow
methods.description: Marks a task flow as failed.

methods.name: finishFlow
methods.description: Marks a task flow as completed.

methods.name: getTaskFlowById
methods.description: Retrieves a task flow by its unique ID.

methods.name: listTaskFlowsForOwnerKey
methods.description: Lists all task flows associated with an owner key.

methods.name: requestFlowCancel
methods.description: Initiates a cancellation process for a task flow.

methods.name: resolveTaskFlowForLookupToken
methods.description: Resolves a task flow based on a lookup token.

methods.name: resetTaskFlowRegistryForTests
methods.description: Resets the task flow registry, typically for testing purposes.

methods.name: resumeFlow
methods.description: Resumes a paused or waiting task flow.

methods.name: setFlowWaiting
methods.description: Sets the task flow state to waiting.

methods.name: syncFlowFromTask
methods.description: Synchronizes flow state from the associated task.

methods.name: updateFlowRecordByIdExpectedRevision
methods.description: Updates a flow record ensuring the expected revision to handle concurrency.
